trap.label: make/let/have/help
trap.wrong: I help them to understand and I let they decide.
trap.right: I help them understand, and I let them decide.
trap.why: Em português “ajudo-os a entender” leva preposição; o brasileiro usa to e pronome sujeito (they). Em inglês, help aceita com ou sem to; let/make/have exigem objeto e base; objeto = them.

fix.wrong: It makes people to lose time.
I have them to meet weekly.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com let: “I allow them to decide.”
Reescreva com have: “I ask them to meet weekly.”
Reescreva com make: “The delay causes people to lose time.”
rewrite.answer: The delay makes people lose time.
